title: Season for Encounters
overview:
Today’s the entrance ceremony at Lyrical Monasterio. I was hovering in front of the school building when a mysterious gyaru suddenly called out to me!?

Is this a mugging!? Wait, this is bad, my wallet's kinda empty. I need to make a withdrawal...

title: Entrance Ceremony and the Headmaster
overview: Since it's an idol school, the cheering for the famous headmaster at the entrance ceremony was wild. But wow, the students here are so colorful. Dragon girls, animal ears, wings, and even giants(?)... I guess I really don't stand out much... Plus, I'm transparent...

title: Dorm Leader Alestiel!
overview: Dorm life begins at last. Having a roommate is fine by me since I shared one with my lil' sis, but huh? Lights-out is that early? But nighttime is when I come alive! It's tough on ghosts out here...
